player.name: Pro Announcement Looper
player.short_description: Loop ProPresenter announcement slides on your TV. Cache slides, set custom timing, schedule presentation switches, and refresh automatically. Requires a reachable ProPresenter computer for your own content; offline demo included.
player.long_description:
Turn your TV into an announcement display with Pro Announcement Looper, a free, open-source utility. Connect to ProPresenter on your local network, add presentations, and loop their enabled slides independently of the service playlist.

Set timing for each presentation, enjoy short dissolves, and keep downloaded images cached during playback. Configure automatic refresh intervals, weekly switches, and manual overrides. Optional local-network commands can switch presentations, resume scheduling, or refresh content. Try the bundled offline demo before connecting.

Requires ProPresenter network/API access and a network connection for initial downloads and updates. Cached images may be reclaimed by Roku and are not guaranteed after a restart. Still images only; video playback is not included. The companion screensaver is a separate app.

Independent community project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Renewed Vision or Roku.

screensaver.name: Pro Announcement Screensaver
screensaver.short_description: Show ProPresenter announcement slides when your Roku becomes idle. Configure presentations, timing, schedules and refresh intervals in the free companion Pro Announcement Looper app. Separate cache and offline demo included.
screensaver.long_description:
Keep announcements visible when your Roku becomes idle. Pro Announcement Screensaver is the standalone companion to Pro Announcement Looper.

Install the free Pro Announcement Looper app from the same publisher to configure your ProPresenter connection, presentations, timing, weekly switches and refresh intervals. Then select Pro Announcement Screensaver in Roku Settings. The screensaver reads the companion settings each time it starts. Both apps must use the same publisher signing identity.

Slides are downloaded into a separate screensaver cache. If no presentations are configured, bundled demo slides are shown. Changes made in the player are picked up the next time the screensaver starts. Roku exits the screensaver when you press a remote button. Remote commands work only in the player.

Requires local-network access to ProPresenter for your own slides and updates. Cache availability is not guaranteed after restart or eviction. Still images only; video playback is not supported.

Free and open source. Independent community project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Renewed Vision or Roku.
